_comment: Flora grafts placed from the shell parts' graft anchors (Config/ShellAnchors/*.json, names in Art/Shells/tools/anchor_spec.py), so they fit whatever head, core, arms and legs a robot wears (Characters/WWOBodyAnchors.cpp). Used instead of the fitted model grafts where a model has anchor_grafts on (Config/CharacterModels.json) or with wwo.AnchorGrafts 1 / -WWOAnchorGrafts, and only for a flora listed here; edit and restart, no build. floras.<flora id>: a list of placements per thing equipped: 'grenade' (any grenade) and each ability id. A placement puts one piece on an anchor ('anchor': its name) or one every spacing_cm along a path ('path': its name; 'range': [from, to] fractions of its length, default [0, 1]). '{s}' in a name means both sides: once with l, once with r (the r one's across offset is mirrored). Each piece is laid in the anchor's frame: out of the surface (n), across (up x n; on a front-facing anchor that is the robot's right), and its up (Head and Core: toward the robot's up; Arms and Legs: along the limb toward the body; along a path: the path's direction). offset: [out, across, up] cm from the anchor; keep it small: an anchor measures the part's surface only at its own point, and a few cm away another shell's surface can stand several cm further out or in (the scout core's codpiece buried pods placed 9 cm above hip_front, or 4 to 8 cm to its side); stay within the anchor's size. along: which way a plate's length runs: 'down' (against up: down the body, down a limb toward the hand or foot; the default), 'up', or 'across'. scale_by_size: the piece grows or shrinks with the anchor's size (its size / size_ref, default 5 cm, kept within 0.6 to 1.6), so a bigger part's flat spot gets a bigger piece. Pieces (FWWOGraftBuilder, all sizes cm): 'plate', a bark slab with glowing cracks: length, width, curve (the radius it bends round, small to wrap a limb; default 30), thickness (default 2), lift (its far end, toward along, raised off the body, default 0), cracked (default true); 'seed_pod', an amber pod hanging straight down from the point on a stalk: length, width, stalk (default 10, 3.5, 4). VoltVine's pieces (FWWOVineGraft, Characters/WWOVineGraft.h; in the fitted grafts' MI_VV_* materials): 'vine', a braided bark rope with a glowing core laid along a chain of paths ('paths': a list of {path, range [from, to] (from > to runs it backward), thickness (times radius), leaf_scale (a number, or [at its start, at its end]), leaves (false: none on this stretch)}, each joined to the one before across the gap between them, so a Core path runs on over a seam into an Arms or Legs path): radius cm (each strand; the rope is about 4 times that thick, its inside edge 'clear' cm off the surface), strands (3), pitch (cm per twist), core (true), taper [start, end] fractions; leaves {every cm, count [min, max] leaves there (the fitted grafts' own whole leaves, each on a green shoot), size [min, max] cm long, hang [min, max] degrees out from straight down (default 5 to 20), skip [start, end] fractions}; pods {at: fractions of the vine's length, size (0.4 is about 12 cm long), prefer: 'front' | 'outer' | 'back' | 'up' | 'down' (turned that way within a few cm)}; tendrils (how many curls along it), tendril_end; wind {radius, pitch, thorns (every cm), thorn_length}: a thinner rope weaving over it. Where a vine passes from one bone to the next, a few cm either side are posed between the two bones every frame (wwo.AnchorVineJoints 0: rigid per bone instead). 'bone_wrap': a vine's line wound round a bone instead of along paths (the hands, the same on every shell): bone, to_bone (its axis runs from the bone toward that one's joint), range, turns, phase, radii [out, across] cm, and the vine's own fields. 'crystal': a glowing crystal pod at an anchor: offset, size, lean [across, up]. 'leaf_fan': count leaves falling from an anchor, out toward the robot's side and down, fanned front to back: offset, size [min, max], down (how steeply; 1 the fitted shoulders'). A section 'grenade.<grenade id>' adds that grenade's own pieces to 'grenade'.

voltvine._comment: VoltVine, after the fitted SK_VV_* grafts (~/Documents/WWO_Flora/tools/make_voltvine_grafts.py). Grenade: the torso vine: from the left hip up across the back (sash_back_r, run backward), over the right shoulder, down across the chest (sash_r), then round the back of the waist on the leaning belt (belt_lean_r: high on the right) to the right hip, its leaves longer on the low (left) side; a thinner strand from the left collar to the middle of the chest (sash_l); two short branches curling round the right of the chest and waist; the grenade's own crystal bulbs on the right hip (1 Volt Grenade, 2 Shock Pool, 3 Snare Mine). Static Charge: from each collar over the shoulder seam coiling down the upper arm (collar_to_shoulder_{s} into upperarm_coil_{s}), leaves falling over the shoulder. Thornfist: coiled round the forearms (forearm_coil_{s}) with a thorny strand weaving over it. Overgrowth: from the waist over the hip seam down the whole leg (waist_to_hip_{s}, the thigh half of leg_spiral_{s}, then shin_coil_{s}), thin on the thigh, thick and leafy on the shin, a second strand down the outside of the shin. Melee Guard: a band round each hand with tiny crystals at the knuckles.
